stories.title: Kim Jong Un oversees North Korea's launch of a missile that uses AI to adjust its flight path
stories.reason: State media said the hypersonic weapon, fired from Wonsan and flying over 700km, can alter its trajectory at low altitude, though Seoul's defense ministry says the launch remained within allied detection and interception capabilities.

stories.title: Mass protests demanding India's election chief resign shake the country for a third day
stories.reason: Opposition leaders in Delhi and Mumbai accuse a voter-roll revision of disenfranchising millions of eligible voters in ways that benefit Modi's BJP, with the 'cockroach' movement that previously ousted a cabinet minister now joining the push to remove commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

stories.title: Micron's revenue nearly quadruples as the memory chipmaker's market cap tops $1 trillion
stories.reason: Fiscal fourth-quarter revenue hit $54.23 billion on a 343% jump in DRAM sales, and guidance for the current quarter came in well above estimates, underscoring how AI-driven memory demand is reshaping the chip industry's biggest winners.

stories.title: Families of two Fox News journalists killed in Ukraine sue the network over their deaths
stories.reason: The suits allege Fox and a star correspondent ignored repeated security warnings before a 2022 attack near Kyiv killed Oleksandra Kuvshynova and cameraman Pierre Zakrzewski, reopening scrutiny of how networks weigh ambition against journalists' safety in war zones.

stories.title: Yemen's army says it killed 700 Houthis in 24 hours as the group claims a strike on an Aramco site
stories.reason: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces say hundreds of strikes hit Houthi positions across Sanaa, Saada and several other fronts, while the Saudi-led coalition dismissed the Houthis' claimed Riyadh-area Aramco strike as a 'misleading' bid to offset their losses.

stories.title: Spanish police clear a 3,000-person migrant camp on a Ceuta beach ahead of a royal visit
stories.reason: Some 350 officers began dismantling the tent settlement that formed after more than 70,000 people crossed from Morocco in July, with the operation's timing tied to King Felipe and Queen Letizia's first visit to the enclave in his 12-year reign.

stories.title: SpaceX's IPO filing reveals Anthropic could pay up to $84.5 billion to rent xAI's data center capacity
stories.reason: The disclosed deal has Anthropic paying $1.25 billion a month for over 300 megawatts of compute through 2029, though most of the commitment can be canceled on 90 days' notice, as Anthropic's infrastructure spending plans reach into the hundreds of billions.

stories.title: Meta publishes six math papers co-written with its Muse Spark AI, five solving previously open problems
stories.reason: Mathematicians used the model's 'Thinking Mode' through an ordinary chat interface, with no custom scaffolding, to help settle questions spanning probability, PDEs and group theory, including a counterexample that resolved a 2024 conjecture.
